freeze.policy: Final freeze before any predictions or Google results on the reserved 41-case confirmation set. Existing 89 and typing148 are observed regression/selection gates. No engine tuning after confirmation.

protocol.ranking: Top-1 exact match descending; equal values share a rank. No composite score. Network services are excluded from local-speed ranking.
protocol.normalization: Trim whitespace and apply Unicode NFC. Roman input is otherwise unchanged.
protocol.references: Every supplied reference for the same Roman token is accepted; repeated inputs are grouped.
protocol.errors: Exceptions, absent responses and empty outputs count as misses and remain in the denominator.
protocol.top5: Match among the first five unique returned suggestions; single-output engines get one candidate.
protocol.cer: Micro Unicode code-point edit distance using the lowest-CER reference per case; may exceed 100%.
protocol.timing: Local engine latency is Node in-process wall-clock time after import and three fixed warmups, one occurrence per query. Google latency is the original network request duration in the snapshot. These timing classes are not directly comparable. UI/model loading and scoring are excluded.
protocol.uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals are descriptive under independent-input assumptions; related forms may be correlated.
protocol.personalization: Off. No reference text or Google output is passed to the engine.
protocol.limitations: Google baseline is the public per-word ne-t-i0-und endpoint, not the complete contextual/personalized Google Translate UI. Strict reference agreement does not establish broad product superiority. The typing check has project-authored references and was used for debugging; the public corpus is not real typing traffic.
